items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I even went and saw some of the Mickey Mouse bands, like Sammy Kaye and those

ctx.x: Totally safe and there was the [inaudible] state even then I realized was the graveyard of bands, but I went and you know, so you’d hear the 2nd rate and 3rd rate bands and you’d hear some people that were… I went to every damn place I could find, whenever, wherever there was

a band, even the bad, I even went and saw some of the Mickey Mouse bands, like Sammy Kaye and those, and you know when you’re that young, you don’t censor that much. I drew the line at Guy Lombardo though.
